response.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates) AS excess_over_average FROM rates WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates) ORDER BY rate DESC

assumptions.assumption: A media type's rate is total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds across its tracks (a weighted ratio), not the average of per-track ratios.

The simple average is the unweighted mean of the per-media-type rates, over media types that have at least one track. Tracks with NULL Bytes add their milliseconds to the denominator only if the SUM includes them. SUM(Milliseconds) counts all tracks of the type, while SUM(Bytes) ignores NULL.
Results are not rounded; excess is the rate minus the average rate.

alternatives.interpretation: Rate per media type is the average of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios, rather than the ratio of totals.
alternatives.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates) AS excess_over_average FROM rates WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates) ORDER BY rate DESC
